name: Horizontal Scroll Section
description: Dark editorial page with an intro, a pinned strip of text and image cards that slides sideways as you scroll with a progress bar, and a closing section with image and link.
contents: Intro section with label, large title, and short text
Pinned horizontal strip of text and image cards with tags and titles
Progress indicator inside the pinned strip
Closing section with image, label, title, and link
behavior: Vertical scroll is converted into horizontal movement while the strip section is pinned by GSAP ScrollTrigger
Progress bar fills as the strip moves
Image cards turn from grayscale to color and zoom on hover

props.name: introText
props.default: Scroll down and the exhibition slides sideways while the section stays pinned in place.

editableByProps: All intro, strip, and closing text, link, and images
Number and type (text or image) of strip cards
Section background, text, and accent colors as Tailwind classes
Scroll speed multiplier and scrub smoothness

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the easing of the horizontal movement
Change card width or spacing in the strip
needsCodeEdit.where: w-[55vw] md:w-[45vw] pr-[12vw] classes on the item wrapper

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Locomotive Scroll and sets overflow hidden on html and body while mounted, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Injects a small style block for Locomotive Scroll classes
Includes full-height intro and closing sections that give the pin scroll room
